remarks:
Welcome to 49 Fennec Lane, a meticulously maintained 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home with over 3,000 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space located in the highly sought-after Williamsville School District. Custom built in 1987 with a design inspired by the architecture of Frank Lloyd Wright, this one-of-a-kind home pairs clean lines and natural materials with modern comfort and everyday convenience.

The first-floor primary suite is a true retreat, featuring two walk-in closets and a his-and-her bath with two showers and heated floors. First-floor laundry adds everyday ease. A working wood-burning fireplace with gas start anchors the living space, making cozy evenings effortless. The office/den on the first floor could easily be used as a 4th bedroom.

Newer Brazilian Cherry hardwood floors add warmth and richness to the office/den and one of the upstairs bedrooms. Another upstairs bedroom features a custom-built office nook, perfect for working from home or quiet study.

Outside, the fully fenced backyard features a composite deck, ideal for entertaining, relaxing, or keeping pets and play areas secure. The large two-car garage offers a floor drain and a newer storm-proof door. New furnace and A/C installed in 2021.

Distinctive, well cared for, and move-in ready, this home offers character and quality craftsmanship throughout. Don't miss this rare opportunity!

Open House: Saturday, October 10th from 11:00am-1:00pm
